title: Parking: notifications that need nobody no longer bring a parked terminal back
summary: Plugin notices and agent-view notices no longer pull a parked terminal back; usage-limit pauses and unknown notice types still do. Classification table tests over every listed type and malformed values.
friction: the machine (7.8 GB) ran out of memory when two dev agents ran their full suites at once; both runs were killed mid-gate and cost about 30 minutes; fixed in-run with a gate lock (mkdir C:/git/maestro-wt/gate-lock) so heavy commands run one at a time
lessons_learned: On this machine, every dev and review brief must tell agents to take the gate lock before npm test, vitest, build or any cargo command; parallel suites do not fit in memory
